# Remove leading "=" for nesting.
inner = base_formula[1:] if base_formula.startswith("=") else base_formula

# If the input already has an outer A4-blank guard, keep it; otherwise add the guard.

formula_text_no_spaces = re.sub(r"\s+", "", base_formula).upper()

    corrected_formula = base_formula
else:
    corrected_formula = f'=IF(A4="","",{inner})'
